description: Look up one US trademark by its registration number (e.g. "4872338"): mark text, serial number, current status and live flag, owners of record, attorney of record, registration/renewal/cancellation dates, international classes and goods/services, with data_as_of. Keyless. Optional api_key switches to USPTO's TSDR case-status record instead.

api_key.description: Optional USPTO TSDR API key. Omit for the keyless register record.

name: get_trademark_by_registration
